cases.name: ParameterSchema_ImplicitLabelText
cases.html:
<form id="form" toolname="mytool" tooldescription="perform task">
      <label>
        LABEL
        <select name="select" required>
          <option value="Option 1">This is option 1</option>
          <option value="Option 2">This is option 2</option>
          <option value="Option 3">This is option 3</option>
        </select>
        <button>Button text</button>
      </label>
    </form>
cases.expected_json: {"type":"object","properties":{"select":{"type":"string","anyOf":[{"type":"string","const":"Option 1","title":"This is option 1"},{"type":"string","const":"Option 2","title":"This is option 2"},{"type":"string","const":"Option 3","title":"This is option 3"}],"enum":["Option 1","Option 2","Option 3"],"description":"LABEL"}},"required":["select"]}
